To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the working capital management is not a key driver of the firm value, as measured by TQ, for all companies, but it is a key driver of firm value for small-sized companies and for growth companies.

the working capital management has no effect on company value for all companies in general, but there is a significant effect on the value of small-sized companies, and there is a significant negative effect on the value for big-sized companies.

working capital management has a positive impact on the value of industrial companies, and that the effect of working capital management on company value is different for companies with different sizes and growth.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between working capital management and the value of the firm.
the impact of the working capital on the company's value in light of differing company size, company growth and debt.
the effect of working capital on company value.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are significant differences in the effect of working capital on company value, according to size.
working capital management has no effect on the value of Jordan industrial companies.
there is a positive relationship between the working capital management and the value of the firm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
working capital is a very important determinant of value.
the working capital management is not a significant variable in the determination of the value of the companies in Jordan.
the results of the study show that the effect of the working-capital-management on company value is affected by the determinants of size and debt.
The main takeaway from our work is that
working capital is a key factor in determining company value.
the size of the companies is the main factor that determines the impact of working capital management on company value.
the size of the company has a significant impact on the working capital management and the company value.
